properties.site-address: Duchess’ High School, Howling Lane, Alnwick
properties.notes: Site allocated for residential development through the Alnwick and Denwick Neighbourhood Plan, with indicative yield of 60 dwellings identified - Site H2-3. Existing school buildings, Council owned and offering potential opportunity for future redevelopment. Scheme to be focussed on brownfield aspect of site, exclusive of adjacent playing fields.
